facts.function: youth snorkeling and swimming equipment with carry bag and waterproof valuables case
facts.form: retail set: swim goggles, snorkel set (mask and snorkel), mesh sport bag, molded plastic beach capsule

gri_path: GRI 1: components fall in different headings: goggles 9004.90, snorkel set 9506.29, mesh bag 4202.92, plastic capsule 3926.90/4202
GRI 3(b): the items are put up together for retail sale to meet the particular need of snorkeling/swimming; the snorkel set gives the essential character by role and value

rejected_alternatives.reason: the goggles do not give the set its essential character
the mesh bag is a container/packing accessory to the set, not its essential character

classification.rationale: The combo pack is a GRI 3(b) retail set of goods of different headings put up together for snorkeling. The snorkel set is the principal article and gives the set its essential character, so the whole pack goes to 9506.29 as other water-sport equipment, statistical line .80. In-force ruling L81175 classified a children's swim combo (mask, snorkel, fins in a case) in 9506.29.0080.
